projects.description: A drone that proves who it is from its silicon.
projects.tag: A drone that proves who it is from its silicon.
lines: # PUF Drone Authentication
IMG0
### A drone that proves who it is from its silicon.
A UAV authentication system built on Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs),
so each drone is identified from its silicon rather than from a stored
credential. Keys are derived on demand from the PUF response, which means no
secret key is kept on the device - nothing at rest to extract or clone.
Built with PUF · UAV · Hardware Security · Key Derivation
[Visit](https://github.com/5aranx/PUF-Based-Drone-Authentication-System)

projects.tag: One ESP32-S3 that is a keyboard, mouse, gamepad and media remote.
lines: # Mayavi
IMG0
### One ESP32-S3 that is a keyboard, mouse, gamepad and media remote.
ESP32-S3 firmware that acts as a Bluetooth LE HID device - keyboard, mouse,
gamepad and media remote - with 11 selectable profiles, plus a Wi-Fi access
point with a browser dashboard and a serial console. A non-blocking payload
runner sits on NVS-backed settings and a LittleFS-hosted JSON API.
Authorized-use limits and security trade-offs, such as the open access point
default and Just Works pairing, are documented.
Built with ESP32-S3 · C++ · PlatformIO · BLE · Wi-Fi AP · LittleFS · NVS
[Visit](https://github.com/5aranx/Mayavi)
